description: This class `ContentItem` encapsulates a content item used in an Android sharing context. It manages reference to either resource IDs or asset file paths for different content types (image or text) and provides methods to obtain the content URI and generate share intents.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Encapsulates a content item for sharing, supporting image and text types, and provides methods for obtaining content URIs and share intents.

methods.name: ContentItem(int, int)
methods.description: Constructor for creating a ContentItem referencing a resource ID.

methods.name: ContentItem(int, String)
methods.description: Constructor for creating a ContentItem referencing an asset file path.

methods.name: getContentUri
methods.description: Returns a Uri to the content if an asset is specified; otherwise, null.

methods.name: getShareIntent
methods.description: Creates and returns an Intent configured for sharing this content item based on its type.
